name.value: Okanagan Lake Provincial Park, South Campground

description.value: A large provincial campground on Okanagan Lake with pebbly beaches, ponderosa pine and sagebrush setting, and panoramic lake views; rattlesnakes inhabit the dry hillsides above camp.

raw_osm.name: Okanagan Lake Provincial Park, South Campground

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms an active frontcountry campground at Okanagan Lake, 11km north of Summerland on Hwy 97, operated by Kaloya Contracting Ltd. A seasonal concession at the south campground gatehouse supports 'Food nearby.' The frontcountry reservations subpage confirms BC Parks accepts reservations at over 110 campgrounds including this park, but no bike-specific amenities, showers, laundry, or charging facilities are mentioned anywhere in the fetched content.
concerns: OSM phone (+1-250-548-0076) and email (info@campokanagan.com) appear to be for the private operator (Kaloya Contracting Ltd.), not BC Parks directly; neither is confirmed on the fetched BC Parks website pages.
No civic address available in OSM; location described only as '11km north of Summerland on Hwy 97' on the website.
Many standard amenity details (showers, potable water, hiker/biker sites) are not described in the fetched content; the park-specific amenity page content may not have been fully captured.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active provincial park campground with 88 sites in a prime Okanagan cycling corridor location; a clear and useful listing for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The operator email domain (campokanagan.com) is distinct from the BC Parks website. Cyclists planning to contact the campground directly should use info@campokanagan.com or +1-250-548-0076 for the on-site operator.
